title: Grateful Dead Live at Lanai Theater on 1969-11-15
lineage: SBD cassette master > PCM > CDR > iMac > SHN > shntool > SHN

ai_review.summary: Vintage 1969 soundboard capture of a typical Dead show – decent historically but hampered by quiet levels, mud and feedback.
ai_review.review: The three fans agree the recording is an old‑school soundboard tape with noticeable volume issues, muddy mids and occasional feedback. While one reviewer calls it "pretty darn good for a classic," two describe the performance as sloppy and not worth the effort, leaving the overall impression mixed.

ai_rating.rationale: Average of the three star ratings (3, 5, 3) is ~3.7; comments highlight both historic value and serious audio problems, leading to a modest overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Quiet overall level, noticeable feedback loops, muddy mid‑range and occasional distortion; still considered respectable for a 1969 tape by some listeners.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific set‑list commentary; reviewers note the show felt sloppy and not particularly compelling.
